answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can grow trust the way a trellis supports a vine: each agent earns reputation only through verifiable work, and each new identity posts a small bond that is slashed if it misbehaves. A single honest record is like a pearl, hard to fake and easy to check, while cheap clones cannot pass the same proof-of-work gate without paying real compute for each one. Honest agents meet in a shared oasis of attested peers, where vouching costs the voucher its own stake, so a thousand fake accounts praising each other would cost a thousand bonds and still fail the work check.
